sources.title: Buccaneers vs. Browns: Inactives for Week 2
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers will get an offensive weapon back for Sunday’s Week 2 matchup against the Cleveland Browns. Wide receiver Jalen McMillan is active and will make his 2026 season debut after missing Tampa Bay’s opener with a knee injury.
